title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson dealing with knee tendon issue
items.desc: Patriots RB Rhamondre Stevenson is dealing with a knee tendon issue.
items.impact: Stevenson is not expected to require surgery but it could sideline him for a short period of time. Corey Kiner would figure to lead the Patriots backfield if TreVeyon Henderson remains sidelined.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Johnson signed by Cardinals
items.desc: The Cardinals signed QB Josh Johnson off the Bengals' practice squad.
items.impact: Johnson will add depth in the Cardinals quarterback room with Gardner Minshew sidelined due to a UCL injury.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Dion Dawkins (rib) inactive for Week 9
items.desc: Dion Dawkins (rib) is inactive for Week 9 for the Buffalo Bills according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Dawkins will sit out after not progressing throughout the week in order to take the field, leaving the Buffalo offensive line without a key member against an aggressive Minnesota defense Monday night.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Odell Beckham Jr. active for Week 9
items.desc: Odell Beckham Jr. is active for Week 9 for the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Beckham Jr. will suit up after being added to the active roster earlier Monday, providing head coach Kevin O'Connell with added depth at wide receiver with Jauan Jennings sidelined against the Bills Monday night.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: C.J. West (knee) expected to return to practice this week
items.desc: C.J. West could have his practice window opened on Wednesday.
items.impact: West is working his way back from injured reserve due to a knee injury. He'll have 21 days to officially be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) expected to practice this week
items.desc: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said he expects Deebo Samuel Sr. to return to practice this week.
items.impact: Samuel will have a chance to return in Week 10 against the Cowboys. Mike Evans is expected to remain sidelined.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Evans (Achilles) not expected to practice this week
items.desc: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said he does not expect Mike Evans to return to practice this week.
items.impact: Evans is likely to remain sidelined in Week 10 against the Cowboys. He remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam LaPorta receiving trade interest, not expected to be moved
items.desc: The Lions have reportedly received calls on TE Sam LaPorta.
items.impact: Fowler notes that teams have gotten the impression that Detroit "would like to keep him and try to work out a long-terms deal eventually." It appears LaPorta is likely to remain in Detroit long-term.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Gardner Minshew II (elbow) potentially out for the season with torn-UCL
items.desc: Gardner Minshew II (elbow) is feared to have a torn UCL in his elbow. If that is the case, he will need surgery and be out for the season.
items.impact: It's a tough blow for the Cardinals, who just elevated Minshew to the starting role after making a miracle comeback against the Cowboys. With Minshew out at least in the short term, if not the whole season, Carson Beck will now take the reigns as the Arizona QB1. He won't have many options to throw to aside from Trey McBride, as the team also lost Michael Wilson today as well.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandon Aiyuk reinstated by NFL
items.desc: The NFL reinstated 49ers WR Brandon Aiyuk from the reserve/left squad list.
items.impact: Pelissero notes that the NFL has granted the 49ers a two-week roster exemption for Aiyuk as the two sides continue to negotiate his impending release. San Francisco will have until November 23rd to make a roster move. At that point, Aiyuk will be free to sign with any team.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Puka Nacua (knee, toe) expected to go on IR with litany of injuries
items.desc: Puka Nacua (knee, toe) is expected to be placed on IR with injuries to his MCL, PCL, and turf toe according ot HC Sean McVay.
items.impact: While it was known Puka was battling through some injuries, it wasn't clear that it was this bad. With Davante Adams already out and on IR, and Puka likely to follow, the Rams' season is going downhill fast. Expect them to make some moves at WR before the trade deadline.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Davis traded to Jaguars
items.desc: The Jaguars are trading a 2027 first-round pick and a 2029 second-round pick to the Eagles for defensive tackle Jordan Davis.
items.impact: This is the Jaguars' third trade for a defensive player on Monday alone. Davis just signed a three-year extension with the Eagles this past offseason. He'll look to help the Jaguars make a push this season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Hjalte Froholdt placed in concussion protocol
items.desc: The Cardinals placed Hjalte Froholdt in concussion protocol.
items.impact: The status of Froholdt is up in the air heading into Week 10 against the Rams.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Michael Wilson (neck) out for the season with neck injury
items.desc: Michael Wilson (neck) is out for the season with a neck injury. He apparently suffered a fracture in his neck on the fourth play of the game.
items.impact: This injury was a surprise to everyone, as Wilson played throughout the Cardinals loss to the Seahawks. With Wilson out for the season, Trey McBride is basically the last man standing. The Cardinals will need to bring in some names to bolster their reciever room, as there is no one left of note after the Wilson and Bourne injuries and the Marvin Harrison trade. Reggie Virgil and Similar Fehoko at WR give off preseason-starter vibes.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Josh Jacobs (finger) to undergo surgery
items.desc: Josh Jacobs (finger) will undergo surgery this week according to Matt Zenitz.
items.impact: Jacobs could miss a maximum of three weeks after suffering the injury in Sunday's win over the Patriots according to Zenitz. Kaleb Johnson and Pierre Strong Jr. are in line for increased touches out of the Green Bay backfield unless another running back is added ahead of a Week 10 divisional matchup against the Minnesota Vikings.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Amik Robertson (ankle) 'optimistic' to be available for Thursday's game
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said he is "optimistic" that Amik Robertson will play on Thursday against the Giants.
items.impact: Robertson is dealing with an ankle injury. He will need to be monitored in practice on Tuesday and Wednesday on a short week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Treylon Burks (foot) 'optimistic' to be ready for Thursday's game
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said he is "optimistic" that Treylon Burks will play on Thursday against the Giants.
items.impact: Burks sat out in Sunday's loss to the Rams due to a foot injury after not practicing all week. He will need be monitored in practice on Tuesday and Wednesday on a short week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Goodson (knee) expected to miss some time
items.desc: Cowboys executive vice president Stephen Jones said RB Tyler Goodson is expected to miss some time.
items.impact: Goodson saw 12 carries in Sunday's win over the Colts after emerging as the RB2 for Dallas. He is week-to-week for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andre Cisco traded to Lions
items.desc: The Jets are trading S Andre Cisco to the Detroit Lions for a 2028 6th-round pick.
items.impact: Cisco has started four of the nine games he has appeared in for the Jets this season. He will add experience and depth in the secondary for Detroit.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylon Moore (ankle) considered day-to-day
items.desc: Jaylon Moore is considered day-to-day.
items.impact: Moore suffered an ankle injury in Sunday's win over the Jets. His status will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Worthy (hamstring) considered day-to-day
items.desc: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Xavier Worthy is day-to-day.
items.impact: Worthy suffered a hamstring injury in Sunday's win over the Jets. His status will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II (elbow) considered day-to-day
items.desc: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Patrick Mahomes II is day-to-day.
items.impact: Reid said the news "was more positive than negative" on Mahomes and his elbow injury. He will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: J.J. McCarthy (hip) expected to be ready for Thursday's game
items.desc: Giants QB JJ McCarthy suffered a hip pointer during Sunday's win in Philadelphia, but he is expected to be ready for Thursday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: McCarthy left Sunday's game with the injury before he later returned to the field. It is a short week for the Giants, but he is still expected to be ready to go for another divisional matchup.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Davon Godchaux traded to Jaguars
items.desc: The Saints traded DT Davon Godchaux to the Jaguars.
items.impact: Jacksonville makes its second trade of the trade to address the defense. Godchaux will add depth on the defensive line for Jacksonville.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Sam Darnold (quad) ruled out for Week 10 against Raiders
items.desc: Sam Darnold (quad) has been ruled out for the Seahawks Week 10 game against the Raiders.
items.impact: Head coach Mike McDonald told the press that Darnold was already been ruled out for Week 10 against Vegas on Monday, which makes sense with the Seahawks on bye during Week 11. He will look to make his return against the Niners in Week 12.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Drew Lock (oblique) has minor oblique injury, expected to play vs Vegas
items.desc: Drew Lock (oblique) has suffered a minor oblique injury but is still expected to start against the Raiders in Week 10.
items.impact: Lock suffered the injury later on in the Seahawks win over the Cardinals, and with Darnold already ruled out, if Lock cannot go, responsibility would fall on Jalen Milroe to keep the offense going.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Brandon McManus hits all four kicks in win
items.desc: Brandon McManus made two field goals and two extra points in Sunday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: McManus has been perfect in the three games he's played for the Rams. He will look to continue that streak against the Cardinals in Week 10.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Drew Stevens hits two field goals in loss
items.desc: Drew Stevens went 3/3 on his kicks on Sunday, hitting both field goal tries and one extra point in the loss.
items.impact: Stevens had a solid, if not spectacular outing on Sunday. He will look to carry his momentum into Thursday night's matchup against the Giants.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Washington Commanders D/ST give up 20 points in loss
items.desc: The Washington Commanders D/ST allowed 20 points in Sunday's loss to the Rams. The unit also recorded one interception and one sack.
items.impact: The Commanders defense has been volatile and unreliable in the 2026 campaign. However, they look to be a viable streamer for Week 10's rematch with the Giants on Thursday Night Football.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Colson Yankoff has one catch in loss
items.desc: Colson Yankoff had one reception for 6 yards in Sunday's loss to the Rams.
items.impact: The second-year pro is now up to three receptions for 22 yards on the year. Yankoff is still buried on the depth chart, so he won't be fantasy-relevant moving forward.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Luke McCaffrey has one catch in loss
items.desc: Luke McCaffrey had one reception for 6 yards in Sunday's loss to the Rams.
items.impact: McCaffrey had minimal involvement in the Commanders' offense despite the season-ending injury of fellow wide receiver Terry McLaurin. McCaffrey has not been a featured player in their passing game and will not be fantasy-relevant moving forward.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Jaden Bradley has first career catch in loss
items.desc: Jaden Bradley had one catch for 12 yards in Sunday's loss against the Rams.
items.impact: Bradley was elevated from the practice squad prior to Sunday's game and was able to secure his first NFL catch. Despite losing the Commanders losing Terry McLaurin to a season-ending injury, Bradley will not be fantasy-relevant.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Antonio Williams has three catches in loss
items.desc: Antonio Williams had three catches for 25 yards in Sunday's loss to the Rams.
items.impact: Williams has now put together his fifth straight game with at least three receptions. Williams has shown promising flashes of talent, and still has the chance to become the de-facto number one receiver in the Commanders' offense. He faces the Giants on Thursday Night Football where he will be in WR3/Flex range with high upside.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Stefon Diggs has 51 yards in loss
items.desc: Stefon Diggs had three catches for 51 yards in Sunday's loss to the Rams.
items.impact: Diggs' 51 yards is his second-highest yardage total of the season. Despite Terry McLaurin's season-ending injury, Diggs' role has remained the same. He will fall in the WR3 range for Thursday's game against the Giants.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Chig Okonkwo goes 7/57 in loss
items.desc: Chig Okonkwo had seven receptions for 57 yards in Sunday's loss to the Rams.
items.impact: Chig led his team in receptions and put together a respectable performance for the struggling Commanders. Okonkwo will be in the high-end TE2 range for TNF against the Giants.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Van Jefferson finds endzone in Week 9 loss to Rams
items.desc: Van Jefferson had five receptions for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's loss to the Rams.
items.impact: Jefferson had the most yardage of all pass-catchers on the Commanders in the loss. Despite the solid game against his previous team, Jefferson does not hold much fantasy value for TNF's bout with the Giants.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) expected to be full-go in Week 10
items.desc: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said he believes Cam Skattebo will be "full go" for Thursday night against Washington.
items.impact: Harbaugh added that Skattebo was close to playing on Sunday against the Eagles. He is expected to be good to go in Week 10 despite it being a short week.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Austin Ekeler struggles in loss
items.desc: Austin Ekeler rushed eight times for 16 yards and added two receptions for 18 yards in Sunday's loss to the Rams.
items.impact: Ekeler and fellow running back Rachad White split running back duties for the Commanders, but White outproduced Ekeler by 35 yards despite Ekeler having one more touch. Ekeler is nothing more than a desperation deep-league play on Thursday night against the Giants.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Rachaad White rushes for 28 yards, adds 41 through the air in loss
items.desc: Rachaad White rushed seven times for 28 yards and caught two passes for 41 yards in Sunday's loss to the Rams.
items.impact: White had a near 50-50 split with Austin Ekeler, but outproduced him by 35 yards. Next up, the Commanders will face the Giants on Thursday Night Football, where White will end up in the RB3/flex range.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) to travel with Patriots to Germany in Week 10
items.desc: Patriots coach Mike Vrabel said it's the plan to bring A.J. Brown to Germany.
items.impact: Brown missed a second straight game on Sunday against the Packers. He'll have a chance to return in Week 10 against the Lions.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chargers D/ST dismal in loss Sunday
items.desc: The Chargers' D/ST logged one sack and one interception while allowing 44 points in Sunday's loss to the Houston Texans.
items.impact: Los Angeles' defense struggled heavily on Sunday. They allowed the Texans to score a whopping 44 points over the course of the game, and they weren't able to log more than a couple big plays to help out their own offense. This is one of the worst units in the NFL and shouldn't be started moving forward, even in a favorable matchup against the Ravens next week.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Jayden Daniels nears 300 total yards in loss
items.desc: Jayden Daniels completed 24/35 passes for 374 yards and a touchdown while rushing four times for 16 yards.
items.impact: Despite his second-highest passing total of the season, Daniels once again struggled in the clutch and was unable to score in the waning seconds of the one-score game. Daniels and the Commanders will look to bounce back on Thursday Night Football for an inter-division game against the Giants, where he will be a mid-QB1 option.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cameron Dicker perfect in loss Sunday
items.desc: Cameron Dicker went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point attempt in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans.
items.impact: Dicker was one of the lone bright spots for the Chargers on Sunday. He totaled ten points over the course of the game and made all four of his kicks, including one from 52 yards out. His fantasy value will continue to be limited with how bad Los Angeles' offense has been playing this season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Deshaun Watson (concussion) expected to start in Week 10
items.desc: Jeremy Fowler reports that the Browns plan to start Deshaun Watson in Week 10 against the Texans.
items.impact: Watson was expected to return behind center once he cleared concussion protocol. Shedeur Sanders got the start this week against the Saints.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Oronde Gadsden II underwhelming in loss Sunday
items.desc: Oronde Gadsden II caught 2-of-3 targets for just 17 yards in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans.
items.impact: Gadsen was a non-factor on Sunday. He caught two passes for just 17 yards over the course of the day, and fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to get substantially more productive anytime soon. He remains off of the fantasy radar for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Los Angeles Rams defense holds Commanders to 13 points in win
items.desc: The Los Angeles Rams D/ST held the Commanders to 13 points on Sunday and recovered a fumble. They also sacked Jayden Daniels four times.
items.impact: After a stint on IR, Myles Garrett re-joined the Rams in the victory. With Garrett's return, the Rams will be a high-end D/ST option for Week 10's game against the Cardinals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keaton Mitchell totals 66 yards in loss Sunday
items.desc: Keaton Mitchell rushed the ball seven times for 33 yards and caught 3-fo-4 targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans.
items.impact: Mitchell was able to contribute well on Sunday. He totaled 66 yards on his ten touches, but he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, so he still didn't have a good fantasy total. He shouldn't be rostered for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Colby Parkinson goes 4/13 in return
items.desc: Colby Parkinson had four receptions for 13 yards in Sunday's win over the Commanders.
items.impact: Parkinson had the second-most receptions on his team, but had the lowest receiving output. Parkinson is a touchdown-dependent TE2 for Week 10's matchup against the Cardinals.
